messages:
alex: Thinking aloud — can we add a tiny "release-factory" flow to the deploy bot for quick pin checks + rollback suggestions?
mira: yes, we need something lighter than the full checklist for small hotfixes. idea: a /deploy-bot check-pin that validates manifest vs running pins and flags drift.
sam: also want an automatic change-window guard. if change window closed, bot should refuse unless --force with an on-call ack.
alex: sketch of commands:
```
# preview what would happen, no side effects
deploy-bot check-pin --service payments --expected v2026-03-18 --preview

# dry-run a rollback suggestion, outputs recommended pins and risk notes
deploy-bot suggest-rollback --service payments --since 2h --format json

# apply rollback after ack
deploy-bot rollback --service payments --to v2026-03-10 --confirm
```
mira: love the preview/dry-run separation. for check-pin, include KV cache TTL and currently active qp (quantization profile) in the report so infra knows if inference variant changed.
sam: can we have the bot attach a one-line reason template for the release notes when it suggests a rollback? e.g. "rollback recommended: perf regression in p99 on model-x" so SREs can paste it.
alex: proposed release note template from deploy side:
```
- Component: payments-inference
- Action: roll back to v2026-03-10
- Trigger: automated p99 spike detection
- Risk: minor config drift (quantization profile mismatch)
- Rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback --service payments --to v2026-03-10 --confirm`
```
deploy-bot: I can implement check-pin, suggest-rollback, and an opinionated notes generator. Will require the release metadata api + access to running-pins index. :robot_face:
alex: also add a short lint step to reject rollbacks that would violate pinned-dataset compatibility (we had that bug last quarter).
mira: +1. add an escape hatch flag but log a mandatory rationale string for audits.
sam: UX note: for change windows, bot should post a notification in #eng-releases and tag the on-call when someone attempts a deploy outside the window. minimal spam — only on attempt.
alex: implementation plan: 1) small api endpoint returns running pins and model meta; 2) bot commands with preview; 3) template generator + one-click paste to release notes modal. 2-week spike?
mira: happy to pair on the modal bits. maybe add a checkbox "auto-create rollback draft" so PMs can review.
sam: pls add unit tests for the pin-lint and an integration test that simulates a closed change window attempt.
alex: ok i'll open a draft PR with the command skeleton and scripts. tagging you both for review. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: created issue #INF-842: "release-factory: check-pin, suggest-rollback, notes template" and scheduled a spike milestone. More details in the ticket.
